programme.title: Hands Up #890 粵
programme.desc: 泰國有個名為「水燈節」的節日，這回的「大世界 小知識」，便準備了關於這節日的三道問題。到來參賽的雙方小朋友均相當聰明，將題目全部答對，觀眾不妨欣賞兩隊的出色表現。而問題是有關水燈的別稱、製作材料，以及水燈節的活動內容。且看小朋友如何憑着細心思考和推理，得出正確答案。玻璃樽可自行吹出泡泡，究竟怎樣可做到？留意「玩轉STEAM樂園」。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #979 粵日
programme.desc: 大野與杉山因為誤會而發生磨擦，結果演變成兩人在星期天各帶領棒球隊決一勝負。小丸子剛巧路過，卻因為山根缺陣而被拉入大野隊頂替。大野隊落後，有機會反敗為勝之際，大野卻不慎扭傷了腳。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊 #102 粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 問問Master Joe #77 粵
programme.desc: 小朋友乘小巴遇上交通意外，在煞車時撞向前座椅背受傷，引起他們思考車輛煞停時乘客向前衝的原因。Master Joe指出這現象與物體的慣性有關，究竟甚麼是「慣性作用」？眾人透過小實驗明白物體在移動中的慣性原理。靜態的物體又可會出現慣性？現實生活中又有哪些例子與慣性有關？Master Joe為大家逐一示範有關實驗。此外，他還解答電郵提問，解釋傷口接觸到水會感到痛楚的原因。

programme.title: 多啦A夢 #476 粵日
programme.desc: 多啦A夢、大雄和靜香坐時光機回到四萬年前的歐洲，遇到貌似胖虎的尼安德特人和貌似小夫的智人。大雄借走「滿載能力錄音帶」，多啦A夢卻罕有地一言不發，大雄使用「思考的人」錄音帶後開始沉思。

programme.title: 音樂公主愛美莉 #21 普
programme.desc: 講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

programme.desc: 小朋友乘小巴遇上交通意外，在煞車時撞向前座椅背受傷，引起他們思考車輛煞停時乘客向前衝的原因。Master Joe指出這現象與物體的慣性有關，究竟甚麼是「慣性作用」？眾人透過小實驗明白物體在移動中的慣性原理。靜態的物體又可會出現慣性？現實生活中又有哪些例子與慣性有關？Master Joe為大家逐一示範有關實驗。此外，他還解答電郵提問，解釋傷口接觸到水會感到痛楚的原因。

programme.title: 多啦A夢 #476 粵日
programme.desc: 多啦A夢、大雄和靜香坐時光機回到四萬年前的歐洲，遇到貌似胖虎的尼安德特人和貌似小夫的智人。大雄借走「滿載能力錄音帶」，多啦A夢卻罕有地一言不發，大雄使用「思考的人」錄音帶後開始沉思。

programme.title: 音樂公主愛美莉 #21 普
programme.desc: 講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

programme.title: Hands Up #890 粵
programme.desc: 泰國有個名為「水燈節」的節日，這回的「大世界 小知識」，便準備了關於這節日的三道問題。到來參賽的雙方小朋友均相當聰明，將題目全部答對，觀眾不妨欣賞兩隊的出色表現。而問題是有關水燈的別稱、製作材料，以及水燈節的活動內容。且看小朋友如何憑着細心思考和推理，得出正確答案。玻璃樽可自行吹出泡泡，究竟怎樣可做到？留意「玩轉STEAM樂園」。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #979 粵日
programme.desc: 大野與杉山因為誤會而發生磨擦，結果演變成兩人在星期天各帶領棒球隊決一勝負。小丸子剛巧路過，卻因為山根缺陣而被拉入大野隊頂替。大野隊落後，有機會反敗為勝之際，大野卻不慎扭傷了腳。

programme.desc: 小朋友乘小巴遇上交通意外，在煞車時撞向前座椅背受傷，引起他們思考車輛煞停時乘客向前衝的原因。Master Joe指出這現象與物體的慣性有關，究竟甚麼是「慣性作用」？眾人透過小實驗明白物體在移動中的慣性原理。靜態的物體又可會出現慣性？現實生活中又有哪些例子與慣性有關？Master Joe為大家逐一示範有關實驗。此外，他還解答電郵提問，解釋傷口接觸到水會感到痛楚的原因。

programme.title: 多啦A夢 #476 粵日
programme.desc: 多啦A夢、大雄和靜香坐時光機回到四萬年前的歐洲，遇到貌似胖虎的尼安德特人和貌似小夫的智人。大雄借走「滿載能力錄音帶」，多啦A夢卻罕有地一言不發，大雄使用「思考的人」錄音帶後開始沉思。

programme.title: 音樂公主愛美莉 #21 普
programme.desc: 講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

programme.title: Hands Up #890 粵
programme.desc: 泰國有個名為「水燈節」的節日，這回的「大世界 小知識」，便準備了關於這節日的三道問題。到來參賽的雙方小朋友均相當聰明，將題目全部答對，觀眾不妨欣賞兩隊的出色表現。而問題是有關水燈的別稱、製作材料，以及水燈節的活動內容。且看小朋友如何憑着細心思考和推理，得出正確答案。玻璃樽可自行吹出泡泡，究竟怎樣可做到？留意「玩轉STEAM樂園」。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #979 粵日
programme.desc: 大野與杉山因為誤會而發生磨擦，結果演變成兩人在星期天各帶領棒球隊決一勝負。小丸子剛巧路過，卻因為山根缺陣而被拉入大野隊頂替。大野隊落後，有機會反敗為勝之際，大野卻不慎扭傷了腳。

programme.title: Hands Up #891 粵
programme.desc: 吹泡泡能為小朋友帶來歡樂，並勾起他們的好奇心。想泡泡「持久」一點，原來關鍵在於調制肥皂水的配方，泡泡師在「Kids’ Notes」公開箇中成分秘密。在家自製泡泡液，除了必備洗潔精、蒸餾水等材料之外，竟然還需要砂糖？嘉賓本是一位魔術師，見小朋友容易被泡泡吸引，從而啟發到將泡泡與魔術結合。嘉賓還帶來一節花式表演，這些招數又是怎樣練成的？另外，這集「小手指工作室」教大家用卡紙「種」出長滿刺的仙人掌。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #980 粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子一班去遠足和賞楓，小杉因不夠飽而四處覓食，聽老師說楓葉可做成天婦羅後深感興趣。嫲嫲走進河裡幫小孩撿皮球，回來後卻發現爺爺送她的手套不見了，嫲嫲不敢說出來，令爺爺胡思亂想。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊 #103 粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 問問Master Joe #78 粵
programme.desc: 小朋友踢足球時，發現轉動中的足球會自動停下來而感好奇，科學科老師吳偉力，解釋原理與「摩擦力」有關。一支筷子如何將膠樽提起？哪些因素會影響摩擦力的大小？把分別載著水和沙的膠樽同時放在斜板上，哪個滾得較遠？吳老師透過多項實驗，讓大家了解摩擦力的「威力」。當鉛筆插入載滿水的膠袋中，為何水卻沒有溢出？日常生活還有甚麼是利用了摩擦力的原理？Master Joe還會解答魚兒在海中組成一排向前游的原因。

programme.title: 多啦A夢 #477 粵日
programme.desc: 多啦A夢讓胖虎吃下靚聲糖，令他短時間內唱出優美歌聲，詎料讓電視台監製聽見，更邀請胖虎上電視唱歌。胖虎舉辦晚宴演唱會，大雄被迫負責賣票，眾人收到消息後爭相走避，最終只賣給出木杉一個。

programme.desc: 小朋友踢足球時，發現轉動中的足球會自動停下來而感好奇，科學科老師吳偉力，解釋原理與「摩擦力」有關。一支筷子如何將膠樽提起？哪些因素會影響摩擦力的大小？把分別載著水和沙的膠樽同時放在斜板上，哪個滾得較遠？吳老師透過多項實驗，讓大家了解摩擦力的「威力」。當鉛筆插入載滿水的膠袋中，為何水卻沒有溢出？日常生活還有甚麼是利用了摩擦力的原理？Master Joe還會解答魚兒在海中組成一排向前游的原因。

programme.title: 多啦A夢 #477 粵日
programme.desc: 多啦A夢讓胖虎吃下靚聲糖，令他短時間內唱出優美歌聲，詎料讓電視台監製聽見，更邀請胖虎上電視唱歌。胖虎舉辦晚宴演唱會，大雄被迫負責賣票，眾人收到消息後爭相走避，最終只賣給出木杉一個。

programme.title: 音樂公主愛美莉 #22 普
programme.desc: 講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

programme.title: Hands Up #891 粵
programme.desc: 吹泡泡能為小朋友帶來歡樂，並勾起他們的好奇心。想泡泡「持久」一點，原來關鍵在於調制肥皂水的配方，泡泡師在「Kids’ Notes」公開箇中成分秘密。在家自製泡泡液，除了必備洗潔精、蒸餾水等材料之外，竟然還需要砂糖？嘉賓本是一位魔術師，見小朋友容易被泡泡吸引，從而啟發到將泡泡與魔術結合。嘉賓還帶來一節花式表演，這些招數又是怎樣練成的？另外，這集「小手指工作室」教大家用卡紙「種」出長滿刺的仙人掌。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #980 粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子一班去遠足和賞楓，小杉因不夠飽而四處覓食，聽老師說楓葉可做成天婦羅後深感興趣。嫲嫲走進河裡幫小孩撿皮球，回來後卻發現爺爺送她的手套不見了，嫲嫲不敢說出來，令爺爺胡思亂想。

programme.desc: 講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

programme.title: Hands Up #891 粵
programme.desc: 吹泡泡能為小朋友帶來歡樂，並勾起他們的好奇心。想泡泡「持久」一點，原來關鍵在於調制肥皂水的配方，泡泡師在「Kids’ Notes」公開箇中成分秘密。在家自製泡泡液，除了必備洗潔精、蒸餾水等材料之外，竟然還需要砂糖？嘉賓本是一位魔術師，見小朋友容易被泡泡吸引，從而啟發到將泡泡與魔術結合。嘉賓還帶來一節花式表演，這些招數又是怎樣練成的？另外，這集「小手指工作室」教大家用卡紙「種」出長滿刺的仙人掌。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #980 粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子一班去遠足和賞楓，小杉因不夠飽而四處覓食，聽老師說楓葉可做成天婦羅後深感興趣。嫲嫲走進河裡幫小孩撿皮球，回來後卻發現爺爺送她的手套不見了，嫲嫲不敢說出來，令爺爺胡思亂想。

programme.title: Hands Up #892 粵
programme.desc: 早前在德國舉行的低音大提琴比賽中，一位香港代表榮獲第二名。主持們細談這位得獎者的故事，更敬佩他對音樂永不放棄的精神。這集「My Little Show」的主角劉宏豐亦非常熱愛音樂，還會為大家帶來長笛獨奏。他提到控制拍子雖然困難，卻會透過不斷練習去克服。此外，「親子小教煮」環節，大、小主持分工合作，炮製「麻糬波波」。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子 #981 粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子與姐姐比試煮漢堡排，並請來中野和小杉加入評判團，小丸子在過程中明白到媽媽造飯的辛勞。小丸子帶鮮花回學校裝飾，詎料被誤會是藤木所為，為博取笹山好感，藤木請求小丸子為他圓謊。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊 #104 粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 問問Master Joe #79 粵
programme.desc: 有小朋友發覺當自己貼著門站立時，腳踭竟無法離地，盧俊瑋老師作出解答。原來這種現象與人類的重心有關，人類在活動時，身體各個部位都會不自覺地移動，以致在某些情況下，未能完全控制自己的身體，就連最靈活的手指也有失控的時候。還有哪些動作是人類無法做到的？Master Joe略施小計，令小朋友產生錯覺，以為自己的手臂縮短了，究竟是怎樣一回事？留意節目自有分曉。

programme.title: 多啦A夢 #478 粵日
programme.desc: 大雄家裡天花漏水、出現老鼠，爸爸又在浴室滑倒，多啦A夢於是拿出「瓦片惡鬼」保護家宅平安。大雄想要新的棒球手套，多啦A夢給他「如願稻草」，只要有耐性，最終必能夠換取到想要的事物。

programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama return to the tree they were born under Its in bad condition They must rescue it quickly without disturbing the nearby animals Its the Barbababiess birthday They all

programme.title: 胡不歸
programme.desc: 趙顰娘與文萍生夫妻恩愛，表兄妹方三郎與可卿分別暗戀兩人，更合謀誣陷顰染上肺癆，唆使生母趕顰離家，逼生娶卿。顰不欲生為難，遂詐死以絕生之愛念。生肝腸寸斷拒再娶，卿與郎良心發現將陰謀道出，顰與生終可團圓。

programme.title: 鐵扇公主神火破天門
programme.desc: 牛魔王與鐵扇公主之子紅孩兒捉了唐僧，孫悟空找來觀音相助，觀音收服紅並收其為徒。唐僧等路經火燄山，需向鐵借扇以撲滅火焰，鐵不肯，雙方起衝突，牛被捉困天門。鐵為救夫火燒天門，時觀音來調停，悟空終成功借扇。

programme.title: 小姐的丈夫
programme.desc: 富家小姐方翠瑩與陸又民邂逅，因民不喜結交富有人家，故瑩隱瞞身分與民交往，後二人更成眷屬。婚後，民得知瑩的身分，無奈接受。民偶遇舊女友盧麗蓮，讓瑩誤會，幸得蓮解釋，瑩與民終明白夫婦應坦誠相對，二人和好。

programme.title: 無字天書
programme.desc: 葛文欽與妻子石珠娘以假的無字天書作交換，騙取各派絕學，寫成有字天書，並以此立派。十年後，欽派養子嘯群剷除邪派，途中群遇上華冰，二人情投意合。五刀派欲吞併武林，教主歐陽魚率眾弟子突襲各人，大戰一觸即發。

programme.title: 殘花淚
programme.desc: 日軍襲港，韓雪花與曾文健帶家人逃命。花到茶樓唱歌維生，卻讓健誤會，幸被母親罵醒，健決參軍。花誕下兒子，卻傳來健身亡消息，花的舊友金老七遂負起照顧花一家的責任。多年後，健與家人重逢，病重的七亦無憾而終。

programme.title: 皇城救母定江山
programme.desc: 魯國王子臨終前託司馬英將國書代為傳送。英冒認魯國王子打敗凌霄將軍迎娶晉國玉霞公主，惜其後被揭發遭放逐。霄與晉妃奪位，幸霞與兒子小龍脫險。龍長大後與英重聚，霞卻被擄走，英與龍去魯國求援，晉室正統終光復。

programme.title: 西遊記上集
programme.desc: 唐三藏往天竺取西經，先後收孫悟空、沙悟淨、豬八戒為徒。四人路上遇到不少妖怪，悟空多番開殺戒，被三藏趕走。牛魔王擄走三藏，八戒和悟淨向悟空求助，悟空把三藏救出，還騙得芭蕉扇弄熄火焰山的火，四人繼續上路。

programme.title: 威風大少惡千金
programme.desc: 孔文禮邂逅周玉萍，兩人迅速發展起來。孔、周兩家為婚事起風波，幸得禮好友高廣良獻計，禮、萍才順利完婚。婚後，孔家以為禮夫綱大振，周家則以為萍御夫有道，豈料一次意外，二人把戲被識破，兩家人鬧得不可開交……

programme.title: 薄命紅顏
programme.desc: 李國英遇梁玉梅被張彪欺凌，奮勇相救，兩人情愫互生。英與梅成婚，彪從中挑撥，令李母對梅不滿將她趕走。英患重病，梅賣唱賺錢，英卻誤會梅貪圖富貴，傷心回家。英的舅父揭穿彪的詭計，英知錯怪梅，李母亦與梅冰釋。

programme.title: 奇俠黑旋風
programme.desc: 黑璇風行俠仗義救人，巧遇打抱不平的一丈紅父女，三人合力救出民女。紅父女賣藝，藍九少看上紅，挾持其父逼她下嫁，紅施計拖延。九少強搶金玉蘭，紅暗中助黑璇風救出蘭，九少追至，紅報官讓九少伏法，成功救出父親。

programme.title: 十年割肉養金龍
programme.desc: 凌青雲出征，與妻王寶珊分離。西妃謀害東宮，太子輾轉被珊收養，改名凌泰隆。其後飢荒連年，珊割肉餵兒將隆養大。雲歸來誤會珊對其不忠，隆亦怪珊不貞，幸終誤會冰釋。平西王助隆回宮除奸登位，珊苦盡甘來與雲團聚。

programme.title: 西遊記下集
programme.desc: （續上集）唐三藏四人於取經路上屢遇妖精，幸一一化險為夷。來到車遲國，孫悟空遇上虎力大仙等妖道，將他們打敗，誰料狙力大仙假扮悟空，離間他與三藏的感情，更將三藏捉去。悟空得觀音幫助救出三藏，師徒冰釋前嫌。

programme.title: 撈世界要醒目
programme.desc: 何業生與張玉琴、楊文樂與顏素莊、胡經牧與沈慕潔，三對夫婦為生活，所做的工作卻並不是自己的專長，弄致笑料百出，誤會重重。其後樂、莊、琴及牧先後因無心工作犯錯而被辭退，幸各人誤打誤撞終得償所願，各展所長。

programme.title: 春殘燕未歸
programme.desc: 區文立一家因三叔欠債逃去而變得一貧如洗，其後立父雙目失明，立又因病而遭公司辭退，更禍不單行，鄰居失火令一家人無處容身。立妻為籌錢險些被逼賣淫，幸被鄰居陳康所救。最終三叔回來清還債項，區家終可度過難關。

programme.title: 神鶴金鷹
programme.desc: 甘慧生因天生三眼遭父遺棄，長大後隨莊玉英學藝。生邂逅少女溫明珠，後珠遭尤霸天擄去，生誤會是甘卓雄所為，於是英與甘妻程秋雲激戰，雲被打傷。雲偶然救出珠，並得知一切真相。英偕生往救雲後，生喜與雄、雲相認。

programme.desc: 袁浩雲(周潤發飾)是個作風剛烈的神探江浪(梁朝偉飾)是一名臥底,他混入集團成為頭目海叔的左右手就在一次警方追查軍火交易的行動中,袁與江相遇,並洞悉其臥底身份,遂力邀他一同殲滅Johnny的犯罪集團

programme.title: 紅場飛龍粵普
programme.desc: 姚龍因目睹殺人事件,被擊暈倒,盡忘舊事八百龍長老見其健碩,訓練他為八百龍殺手訓練期滿時同伴被殺身亡,命龍追查真兇龍在香港重遇妻子霧美,美努力讓丈夫恢復記憶,卻惹來追殺龍為救霧美,力戰組織首領

programme.title: 八寶奇兵粵普
programme.desc: 匪幫首領李大東被女幹探常洛紅打至重傷,逃至廣州招攬前公安福摩斯,莊勁等七人,企圖返港進行連串械劫案訓練期間,七人偷偷往舞廳見識,結交了黑社會頭目天九,並得悉大東的真正陰謀此時,他們也揭發女教練原來是警方臥底探員為救女教練,七人施展混身解數,八寶盡數,合力對抗大東與其匪幫

programme.title: 明月幾時有粵
programme.desc: 以東江縱隊生死大營救事件為敘事線索,講述以香港傳奇女性方姑為代表的仁人志士,在1940年亂世中的香港展開生死救援的故事影片由一系列黑白片段串聯而成以一位年邁的抗戰老兵鄭家彬梁家輝飾的回憶貫穿全片日軍佔領香港後,為了讓身在英屬香港的茅盾,鄒韜奮,夏衍等多位中國文化名人乘船逃回中國內地,以劉黑仔為主要代表的抗日短槍隊成員積極擔負起這些名人的安全轉移任務茅盾夫婦由於租住在教師方蘭家裏,方蘭

programme.title: 行運一條龍粵普
programme.desc: 行運茶餐廳是一間傳統港式茶餐廳,其中招牌蛋撻及奶茶更是賣到街知巷聞茶餐廳李老板(吳孟達飾)獨力撫養獨生子得男(陳曉東飾),茶餐廳中年資最老的阿水(周星馳飾)不但係茶餐廳專家,亦是眾所週知的情場聖手

programme.title: 我愛扭紋柴粵普
programme.desc: 吳山水(周潤發飾)是新界圍頭村村長,有一個青梅竹馬女友郭飛螢(鄭裕玲飾)郭數年前移民外國,其後回港找吳,然而兩人生活圈子不同,故顯得隔膜重重

programme.title: 驚天救援普
programme.desc: 一場突如其來的地震波及整個灌城化工園區,管道泄漏觸發爆炸不斷濃煙滾滾,火光沖天,災難迅速升級,如果任其蔓延,整座城市將被夷為平地面對要救火又要救人的嚴峻考驗,消防救援站一眾隊員第一時間奔赴重災區,危難時刻爭分奪秒,用生命守護生命

programme.title: 人肉叉燒飽II之天誅地滅粵普
programme.desc: 昌與娟兩夫婦二人合開一家燒臘飯店過著人人稱羨的生活因收留大陸親戚亞鳳在飯店當幫手,發生感情問題娟招來殺身之禍,為了毀屍,娟被燒烤成臘味,供飯店食客喫光

programme.title: 鴨王2粵普
programme.desc: 何巨峯,一代鴨王,做過歌手明星現在很少人叫他做鴨王,多數叫他做峯哥,更收入室徒弟 Dick在一次遊艇派對上,峯巧遇第一次參加的電視台三四線姐仔MonicaMonica 突然家中有急事,要立刻回去,峯幫忙用水上電單車帶 Monica回岸,Monica 感激而且對峯有好印象Monica 回家後得知母親病情嚴重,需要一大筆錢做手術

programme.title: 重口味粵普
programme.desc: 顏千民和邱月清兩位大學生學校宿舍床位不足,搬到了紅燈區的一所大樓,而這座大樓裡住的都是妓女,他二人也因此被電視報導二人想近水樓台先得月的嫖一次,卻出現各種狀況千民邂逅了甘做他人小三的林保怡,並深深地愛上了她,將保怡當做意淫對象

programme.title: 愛情色香味粵普

programme.title: 冥婚

programme.title: 看不見的他們
programme.desc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…

programme.title: Guns of Eden
programme.desc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民

programme.title: 鍾馗降魔
programme.desc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.title: 紙人回魂
programme.desc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?

programme.title: 江湖三女俠
programme.desc: 故事講述,胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍,若能奪得,必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館,稱霸江湖

programme.title: 千王鬥千霸
programme.desc: 名震賭壇的千王與其拍檔受命調查一位上海賭界大亨,懷疑其以賭場為掩護從事間諜活動。兩人深入危機四伏的賭局世界,在層層布局與試探中步步為營,與強敵展開一場關乎生死與榮耀的鬥智對決。

programme.title: 玫瑰我愛你
programme.desc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。

programme.title: 老夫子
programme.desc: 與老夫子一起經歷連串的漫畫故事,看他和他傻頭傻腦的好友大番薯如何為抱得美人歸而弄至笑話連篇!

programme.title: 痳瘋怪拳
programme.desc: 鐵橋三發覺林縣官與鎮南醫局主持孟平勾結販毒,被追殺,幸得漁家女採嬌所救。採嬌乾爹醉公公介紹鐵到歐陽洪的雜貨店送貨,因而認識酒樓夥計老鼠仔。林與孟查知鐵下落,欲加害鐵,反而使歐陽洪無辜被害。鐵逃入海幢寺,得玄光大師傳授五郎八卦棍,遂與老鼠仔往找孟平報仇…

programme.title: 乾隆皇君臣鬥智
programme.desc: 翰林院大學士劉墉機智多謀,口才了得,常難倒乾隆。乾隆心中不忿,欲設計刁難他,但劉墉人急智生,妙語如珠,反令乾隆又再語塞。

programme.title: 怪俠
programme.desc: 怪俠江丹楓全家都被土匪殺害,遂誓必殺盡此等敗類。一次,江殺土匪沙如虎,沙臨終時哀求江將遺物交予其妹秀秀,江允之;秀得知兄為江所殺,憤然拔刀將他砍傷,但她又後悔傷江,因其兄罪應該死,遂留江在家養傷,但江的行蹤已被盜首黃天霸發現

programme.title: 花街時代
programme.desc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。

programme.title: 洪熙官
programme.desc: 清廷走狗白眉道人焚毀少林寺後,繼續追捕殘存的少林弟子。洪熙官在逃亡期間遇見了方詠春,兩人墜入愛河結為夫婦,並育有一子名為文定。洪熙官最終被白眉所殺,文定決心融合父母遺留下的武藝,創立虎鶴雙形拳,以報父仇。

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋,其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿,意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出,孝文感於貞蓮真情,決意回鄉稟明母親,迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後,貞蓮萬念俱灰,竟狂飲毒酒,以圖自盡

programme.title: 龍虎會風雲
programme.desc: 故事描述,金兵侵入,身負重傷的未國將軍囑其女、羅烈及張佩山飾的的愛徒,保護太上皇玉璽,不斷出計,最終難免決一死戰

programme.title: 後門
programme.desc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編,故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年,膝下猶虛,對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚,孤苦伶仃,徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女,琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現,要接回阿琳;徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉,毅然將阿琳交回親母。

programme.title: 乾隆下揚州
programme.desc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡,這次得大臣和大學士陪行,他們一行三人來到揚州,期間遇上不少趣事。

programme.title: 陰陽刀
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?

programme.title: 陰陽刀
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?

programme.title: 弟子也瘋狂
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官與胡惠乾三位俗家弟子初入少林,拜於南院戒嗔大師門下習武。然而,三人常與出家弟子悟清較勁切磋,寺中從此喧嚷不絕,連方丈見此情景亦不免啼笑皆非。

programme.title: 六刺客
programme.desc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡,魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上,卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客,再與他們結盟,密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位,令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客,最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位?

programme.title: 黑店
programme.desc: 故事講述,江湖上傳出消息,巡撫海剛峰辭官歸里,所攜箱篋中珠寶價值連城,於是引起了一些歹人的覬覦。高家店店主高山峰、其姘婦鄧三娘,以及數幫黑道人物,均於高家店埋伏,準備等待海剛峰經過之時伺機下手…

programme.title: 武則天
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。

programme.title: 毒龍潭
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙,盜去師父的玉龍劍,並生下一子一女;後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭,唐抱子虞江逃走,女青兒則歸師公門下;二十年後,劍再次被盜,青女扮男裝,私下尋劍,卻遇樊舊友天涯客

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會

programme.title: 瘋猴
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。

programme.title: 千門八將
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述,正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次,他在與“賭魔”的賭局中,被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後,賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇,正將被賭魔以千術擊敗,含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇,邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博

programme.title: 風花雪月
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路

programme.title: 少林傳人
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位,率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮;皇帝見大勢已去,命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下,大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養,法號道行,習得少林絕技;二太子則易名五子泰,由丞相撫養。多年後,五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」,與道行相遇,卻不知對方正是親兄弟……

programme.title: 梅山收七怪
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃,但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間,導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪,否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 惡爺
programme.desc: 故事講述,惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋,蘇老闆欺善怕惡,把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡,遂暗中模仿其動作練武;一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾,阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃…

programme.title: 惡爺
programme.desc: 故事講述,惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋,蘇老闆欺善怕惡,把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡,遂暗中模仿其動作練武;一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾,阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃…

programme.title: 太極拳
programme.desc: 顧定是太極高手,卻隱藏身份為一名建築工人。當他的女朋友被惡霸強暴後,顧定唯有迫不得已出手讓惡霸受到應有的懲罰,彰顯公義。

programme.title: 新不了情
programme.desc: 歌女青青與建築師湯鵬南原是一對感情深厚的情侶,可惜好景不常,湯家突遭巨變,青青不惜出賣自己肉體以相助鵬南,想不到竟被鵬南誤會而導致倆人分手。後來鵬南得知事情始末,欲挽回感情,可惜青青已患上絕症。

programme.title: 大俠沈勝衣

programme.title: 動物感官世界 #6
programme.desc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: 窺探塔斯馬尼亞惡魔的溫柔一面,與一隻具冒險精神的海龜相遇,並與小鹿一起享受家庭聚餐與800公斤的公牛斯普德踢足球,了解貓頭鷹迪格在保育者尼格爾的癌症治療期間,如何為他帶來安慰

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #1
programme.desc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #1
programme.desc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望���南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #2
programme.desc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #3
programme.desc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #4
programme.desc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #1
programme.desc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #1
programme.desc: 佛羅里達州以其沙質海岸而聞名 - 而且有很多地方可供參觀佛羅里達擁有美國大陸任何一個州最多潮汐的海岸線這些海濱遊樂場亦是受著威脅和瀕危物種的重要棲息地

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.desc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚

programme.title: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話

programme.title: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
programme.desc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #1 英普
programme.desc: 踏上前往斯奈爾斯群島原始荒野的冒險之旅,這裡是一片遠離波濤洶湧大海的動物保護區在這裡,與斯島黃眉企鵝群一起跳舞,與巨鹱和灰鹱一同翱翔,與巨型海獅一起咆哮

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #2 英普
programme.desc: 啟程前往新西蘭的奧塔哥半島,這裡是瀕臨滅絕的海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的繁殖地在這裡,能夠看到海獅,信天翁,紅嘴鷗,白頭燕鷗和仙鋸鹱求偶與繁衍生息的場景

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #3
programme.desc: 巴哈馬被稱為水底電影世界的首都荷里活已經到訪這裡幾十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底製作史詩式的電影和電視戲劇節目,其中的大熱景點包括許多電影般的沉船

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #3
programme.desc: 墨西哥尤卡坦半島是海龜和馬尾藻的家園,同時也是旅遊聖地;三者如何和諧共存?這個寶地可以持續發展嗎?揭開這個墨西哥海灘背後的秘密,包括每年舉行的一個古老分娩儀式

programme.title: 阿拉伯海 #1
programme.desc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標

programme.title: 阿拉伯海 #2
programme.desc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害

programme.title: 野外紀事 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊

programme.title: 野外紀事 #4 英普
programme.desc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化

programme.title: 動物感官世界 #6
programme.desc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: 窺探塔斯馬尼亞惡魔的溫柔一面,與一隻具冒險精神的海龜相遇,並與小鹿一起享受家庭聚餐與800公斤的公牛斯普德踢足球,了解貓頭鷹迪格在保育者尼格爾的癌症治療期間,如何為他帶來安慰

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.desc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #1
programme.desc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望���南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #2
programme.desc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #3
programme.desc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #4
programme.desc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在

programme.title: 萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #1
programme.desc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #2
programme.desc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務

programme.title: 女神們 #1
programme.desc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛

programme.title: ABBA樂團:歐洲歌唱大賽後的半世紀

programme.title: 芭比的故事

programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#114粵
programme.desc: 慶與喜不停離開香港，又留書失蹤。高家眾人終發起「尋親團」，舉家到中山欲查明究竟。亨得悉此事後，主動協助高家眾人，更說將安排豪華房車接送，大屋別墅任住。當眾人到達中山後，卻有滿籮不幸的事件正在等候他們。

programme.title: 夢華錄#20粵普
programme.desc: 三娘為被學生欺負的杜長風解圍，杜長風感激不已。千帆終於醒來，並意識到自己只是齊牧的棋子，對齊牧心灰意冷。引章聽到三娘說千帆和盼兒快要成親，才知道只有自己被蒙在鼓裡，毅然跑去找沈如啄，向他示好。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
食平D粵
programme.desc: 醬料可令味道昇華。原來想要南乳煮得好，下鍋前有個步驟必定要做。想不到肥媽只需6元便可煮出蝦醬啫啫生菜煲，而且只要兩個步驟，既便宜又快捷。「大廚平煮」有名廚指點，在家亦能煮出貴價的意式雲吞。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 充足的睡眠十分重要，但如何才算「充足」？都市人常見的失眠成因甚多，部份因素更會互相影響！「睡眠衛生」是指一系列幫助提升睡眠質量的方法，又有甚麼壞習慣要避免？Louis Yan甄澤權將舉行首個紅館個人魔術演出，他到來預告一些特別表演環節，當中會挑戰世界十大危險魔術之一？他曾登上不同的魔術舞台，卻難忘一次準備前赴拉斯維加斯表演的經歷，究竟發生何事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「太陽肉餅」，維他命D夠豐富！

programme.title: HOME即是識粵

programme.desc: 長者於藥行使用醫療券購買中藥材及乾貨，被收費八千元。當他要求提供收據時，店方索取二百元費用，但收據內容與實際購買商品有出入？網上有人聲稱為報復出軌丈夫，免費送出遊戲機，但要求獲贈者提供個人資料，疑是詐騙。被指裝修糾界「丁蟹」的裝修公司負責人現身澄清，並指己方才是受害者，與新居事主各執一詞。節目組調查後發現，涉事裝修公司另有前科……《中年好聲音4》舉行宣傳活動、周柏豪出席學界籃球賽啟動禮，送上花絮。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2824粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 力蓮要兼顧市場部，工作繁重，瑞輝建議找可信任之人代勞，她遂將若水空降為市場部暫代主管。若水立即接手大量工作，苦不堪言。其實力蓮另有盤算，龔燁識破其意圖，故意讓力蓮發現他與若水頻頻爭吵，並表明他不會助若水處理市場部的工作，試圖令力蓮知難而退，不再難為若水，怎料卻適得其反。力蓮設法「懲罰」若水，龔燁後來得知若水要應付一位好色客人，擔心她出事，遂前往察看，詎料……

programme.title: 鼎植口腔呈獻：香港探秘地圖#16粵PG
programme.desc: 探秘地圖的問米影片，成功引起金夫人對頻道的關注。文彬察覺畢萍對他有所迴避，故與一臣夾計，上演一齣放棄愛慕畢萍的戲碼，畢萍信以為真。秀儀探訪巫姑單位後，噩夢頻生，一臣建議秀儀再找巫姑尋求答案。畢鳴陪秀儀找巫姑，巫姑問米竟招來秀儀的母親上身與秀儀對話，秀儀回憶起兒時零碎往事。畢鳴意外見到秀儀腋下真有Rocky提及的疤痕，遂與文彬計劃測試秀儀。畢萍撞見，制止二人。畢萍直覺秀儀出現古怪情況，與一臣有關……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：成何體統#21粵普
programme.desc: 夏侯澹留信告知晚音他穿越的實情，晚音按信中安排趕往沛陽。官兵一路追捕，危急關頭，曾受晚音救助的啞女小賊帶她躲藏。端王逼夏侯澹寫遺詔由其攝政，卻反被嘲笑其懦弱。晚音為感激啞女帶路往沛陽為她起名花花。

programme.title: K Cash找數王呈獻：夫妻肺片粵PG
programme.desc: 育有小朋友後，周志康自覺已不被太太重視？陳展鵬反指另一半於婚後多了來電！對於生B後欠缺獨處時間，兩嘉賓似乎都接受得來。照料子女是偏重於女性的職責，若遇上豬隊友，主持吳若希寧願對方「撓埋雙手」！雨僑覺得丈夫羅力威拍拖時夠細心，到湊小朋友卻是另一回事！賴慰玲則稱讚丈夫是神隊友。會照顧小孩的還有「四大長老」，輔導心理學家道出男士要記下三個重點，以應對婆媳糾紛。父母於原家庭的出生次序亦影響管教子女方針？

無名天使3D#14粵PG
programme.desc: 麗花等接待拉美耶，其保鑣李天華態度囂張，令麗花甚為不滿。小嫻告訴樂琦，少峰要求離婚，樂琦大吃一驚。少峰表明會為樂琦離婚，樂琦即時拒絕了他。少峰苦苦相逼，樂琦時碰上堅強，遂找堅強幫忙，堅強認出樂琦是當日救他的警花，傾慕不已。堅強發現樂琦不慎遺下口紅，誤會樂琦對他有意。少峰苦等樂琦，樂琦拒而不見，時堅強送回口紅，樂琦借他解圍，故意和他親熱，堅強以為飛來艷福。寶兒和一鳴拍拖，甜蜜非常，寶兒決定把拍拖一事保密。拉美耶遇襲，天華和麗花合力營救，化解危機，二人行動合拍，終化敵為友。

programme.title: 夢華錄#20粵普

programme.desc: 原來慶這段日子頻頻失蹤，目的是尋找失散的弟弟、家族隱藏的族譜及寶藏。眾人為避免秘密洩漏，竟狠心將亨排除在外。對於突然被疏離，亨憤憤不平。另一方面，眾人努力搜查後，發現寶藏竟埋藏於亨所新購入的別墅當中。

programme.title: 夢華錄#21粵普
programme.desc: 歐陽旭當清客，被路經西京的柯政訓斥，柯政不接受其辯解，還將他過往所贈之物全部歸還。千帆查閱盼兒父親案的卷宗，令他不知如何面對盼兒，連盼兒需要錢開酒樓也讓陳廉跑腿，恰巧他又被安排接洽北使，更是分身不暇。

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 三文魚含豐富的奧米加3，肥媽用44元便煮出三文魚三吃，而且只需兩個步驟便煮出名貴日菜鹽燒三文魚頭，魚頭香脆可口，連骨頭亦可食用。除了用胡椒去除三文魚的腥味外，肥媽還另有秘訣。「大廚平煮」有鴛鴦蝦多士。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿自參加無綫電視第18期藝員訓練班入行，轉瞬已二十五載。他近年多棲發展，既是演員、監製，又身兼飲食集團創意總監，更是兩子之父，認為哪個身分最具挑戰？諾懿亮相節目，分享育兒心得，以及多年的演藝得着。「跟大廚去搵食」，許美德師傅接力登場，引領大王、菲比品味上海名菜，「蔥燒海參」、「干燒明蝦球」、「樟茶大鴨」等大菜悉數上桌，展現上海菜的精緻技藝。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「豆醬蒜苗薑爆雞」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 接着的動作題是要令木板上的劃痕變淡，「孖妹」與兩隊猛男對壘，某隊更因大力擦木板而打翻物品，認真激烈。來到從雪櫃找答案，究竟甚麼物品能去除衣物上的油性筆跡？兩隊均鎖定「熟米飯」作目標，可會是正確答案？踏入搶答題回合，經過三條問題，某藝人隊暫時領先，令人大跌眼鏡。「朱古力」是裝修術語，但裝修老闆、油漆工人都不知為何物！有隊伍於尾聲連續答對兩題追至與對手同分，要以決勝題分高低，能否延續後上氣勢一舉晉級？

programme.title: 街坊財爺#22粵PG
programme.desc: 金仔為救露絲想盡方法，終於病倒。蔣嬌乘機軟禁金仔，霸佔財務公司，讓行健、Joey加入公司，俊軒當眾支持。耀宗、瑪莉闖入戴家見到金仔，金仔向瑪莉求救。瑪莉、宇森搬進戴家，宇森與金仔暗中商量反擊大計。行健讓蔣嬌參加財務形象大使選舉，宇森、瑪莉出現，指金仔已讓宇森加入公司，並參加選舉。選舉宴會中，宇森安排懷疑被騙的客戶莊太向行健質問，但行健約了莊生前來，莊太只好啞忍。蔣嬌對行健不滿，二人關係出現暗湧。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普

programme.title: 高朋滿座#115粵

programme.title: HOME即是識粵

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2826粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威對某位博士研發的返老還童科研技術甚感興趣，欲製成藥品推出市場，遂前往實驗室了解，卻遇上阻滯，原來天娥、秀琴在暗中「搞鬼」。因某些理由，她們決意阻止敢威再與博士見面，但事與願違。其後，她們分別因故出埠，但誤以為對方會留下來監測敢威。二人回來後發現敢威有不少改變，似有古怪。敢威本已相約博士再於實驗室見面，天娥遂以非常手段，「製造」外面世界很危險的假像，迫使敢威留在住所，怎料卻生變故……

programme.title: 鼎植口腔呈獻：香港探秘地圖#18粵PG
programme.desc: 文彬父母的龕位遭墳場老鼠破壞，父親的陪葬品名錶被竊；一臣其後稱用「神通」助文彬尋回。其後，文彬卻發現尋錶一事似有內情。一臣從金夫人給予的一堆不記名頭髮樣本中，點出龍貴的頭髮，意指龍貴是金年失蹤前最後見到的人，金夫人愕然。龍貴得悉金夫人懷疑他，欲挽回對方信任……華富邨街坊根叔向文彬指稱，一臣與其母是舊相識，文彬感愕然……一臣本約了金夫人見面，出現的卻是龍貴……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：成何體統#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 晚音拒守沛陽，誓與澹共進退。堇天臨終前託爾嵐照顧摯友，爾嵐含淚應允。端王發現皇帝遺體為假，禁軍搜查中軍。晚音命啞女將火槍塞入將領身上，引發混亂。曹安被殺，中軍趁勢攻城。澹控制禁軍統領，最終叛亂平定。

programme.title: K Cash找數王呈獻：夫妻肺片粵PG
programme.desc: 前度都曾有值得欣賞之處，何依婷回想生病時獲窩心照料；婉婉為拉拉鍊一幕心動？然而成為舊愛也有原因，莊思敏曾被出軌；依婷試過鬧分手時遭討回買手袋的錢，霸氣寫支票趕走男方！另一半身邊總有豬朋狗友？支嚳儀模仿特質，演得神似！周吉佩收過不少「追魂Call」，也揭太太曾有已嫁朋友四出鬼混；譚輝智則憶述被女方的朋友嫌棄。婚姻治療師加入「互片」，直言問題源於夫妻間沒用心經營關係，更為即興入戲的依婷與吉吉化解衝突。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
無名天使3D#16粵PG
programme.desc: 寶兒和一鳴情到濃時在電梯內親熱，被堅強發現，與麗花同謀逼二人公開承認拍拖，二人果然中計。堅強對樂琦異常痴纏，樂琦大吃不消。堅強遇上少峰，少峰對他冷嘲熱諷，堅強表明深愛樂琦，會努力解決二人身份懸殊的問題，時樂琦聽到堅強愛的宣言，感動不已，決定投向堅強懷抱。學文出獄，樂琦找到污點證人指證他，證人卻在安全屋自殺，醒來後即反咬反恐組濫權逼供令他自殺，樂琦知是學文的詭計。天華向麗花示愛，麗花斷然拒絕。學文部署復仇大計，重金禮聘天華當其保鑣，天華得知將與麗花作對，大感為難。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: ADHD學童溫習時，最大困難通常是專注力不足、容易拖延。精神科醫生建議將溫習過程簡短及多樣化，可怎樣做到？醫生提到藥物有助相關學童改善專注力與控制衝動，同時仍需家庭支援！濕疹一般有甚麼成因？皮膚科醫生細說皮膚裂口、致敏源、壓力大的影響；嚴重與否是如何界定？此外，醫生亦帶來治療詳情。有患者或擔心塗類固醇會加重病情，醫生就此為大家去除誤解。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「甜酸汁煎石斑魚」，呈現泰式風味。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 兩隊同門歌手泳兒與黃明德、許靖韻和艾妮，齊來挑戰家事難題，有人卻自言是稱職「媽寶」？洗碗用綠色百潔布或黃色海綿，「洗碗達人」泳兒原來一直用錯方法！曾任職護士的艾妮引用專業經驗答床褥題，能否保住面子？晾胸圍防變形之法，全場唯一男子組解題時竟說得頭頭是道……猜猜「矽膠保護套」用途，有愛的婆孫隊搶分兼搶Fo！動作題回合，泳德隊與兩組素人鬥快自製並點起橙皮蠟燭，卻同樣不跟教學片步驟，偏要把整個燈連肉切開？

programme.title: 街坊財爺#23粵PG
programme.desc: 行健打算借錢兼入股日本公司開發稀土，宇森、耀宗反對不果。耀宗對俊軒多番維護行健，大表不滿。俊軒發脾氣駕車離開，誤撞警察，面臨停牌；行健乘機拉攏俊軒幹大事，俊軒心動。行健派Joey對付耀宗，Joey扮可憐遭毒打，耀宗相救，二人關係拉近。江湖叔父找金仔打麻雀，蔣嬌賭癮大發搶著開賭。金仔與宇森返回公司，與油王談生意；蔣嬌知道中計，想辦法搶先與油王簽約，誰料油田出問題，公司蝕大錢。蔣嬌遷怒行健，行健大怒。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#116粵
programme.desc: 高家與麗的初戀情人家明遇上，最後更被他騙去金錢財物。慶為了尋族譜覓親弟，竟授麗等陪亨遊山玩水，希望趁機潛入別墅進行搜索。亨只覺麗、義、情、溢突然加入自己，大喜不已，而慶的「尋寶特工隊」則展開工作。

programme.title: 夢華錄#22粵普
programme.desc: 千帆自得知蕭欽言就是害盼兒落入賤籍的始作俑者，一直對她避而不見。但當他知道盼兒在東京遇到困難，不惜擅離職守也要趕回去，卻因受傷過重而陷入昏迷。歐陽旭帶著夜宴圖欲要投靠齊牧，卻遭到刁難。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 好聽的歌憑旋律入耳，以歌詞入肉，填詞人功不可沒；鄭國江與林振強的作品篇篇精彩，字字珠璣，無愧為詞壇鬼才。陳美玲、麥潔文、王馨平、張崇基、張崇德、陳柏宇、林奕匡、鄭俊弘齊聚一堂，演繹他倆填詞的經典作品。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Tupperware Freezable 5-Container Set
programme.desc: The Tupperware Freezable 5-Container Set makes meal prep and long-term storage easy, locking in freshness and flavour. Tupperware's No. 1 freezing containers feature a speedy-freeze design and flexible material for easy unmolding. Available in multiple sizes, there's a perfect container for every freezer storage need. Tupperware 冷冻保鲜 5 件套让备餐和长期储存变得便捷，有效锁住食物的新鲜度。作为 Tupperware 畅销第一的冷冻容器，它采用快速冷冻设计与柔韧材质，冷冻后轻松脱模。多种尺寸组合，能轻松满足各种冷冻储存的需求。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - i-Running TM-299 Foldable Treadmill
programme.desc: Compact, slim, and ready to use straight out of the box. Walk or jog anytime with quiet operation, shock absorption for joint comfort, and adjustable speed and incline. Fold it flat for easy storage—your convenient home fitness solution. 轻巧省空间，开箱即用。安静运行、减震护膝，可调速度与坡度，适合快走与慢跑。折叠后薄至12公分，轻松收纳床底或靠墙摆放，让居家运动更轻松自在。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - ASD Hybrid 3-ply Hex Wok 32 & 36cm
programme.desc: This cookware is made with strong stainless steel and a long-lasting non-stick coating from Whitford (USA). Its 7-layer design ensures even heat distribution and helps keep heat longer, providing great cooking results every time. Perfect for those looking for high-quality, easy-to-use kitchen tools. ASD爱仕达316不锈钢不粘炒锅采用三层钢结构与耐高温不粘涂层，结合了不锈钢的耐用与不粘锅的便捷。蜂窝纹理设计省油防粘，食材加热均匀，不怕铁铲和钢丝球刮擦，适合烹饪各种坚硬食材。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Acerpure Clean V2 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner
programme.desc: Transform the way you clean with the Acerpure Clean V2 cordless vacuum, designed for modern living. Its ultra-strong suction power and multi-stage filtration system capture even the finest dust in your homes. Lightweight yet powerful, it makes cleaning quick and comfortable with its ergonomic design and long-lasting battery. Acerpure V2 无线吸尘机， 四种刷头，满足全屋清洁需求。 1.37公斤超轻无线主机，轻盈好超控。三档模式，20000pa强劲气旋吸力，灰尘一扫而空。多角度掌控自如，让您更顺畅地左右移动，滑行或转向。轻巧却强劲有力，是您最佳的清洁伙伴。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - LAC Joint Protect
programme.desc: The jelly form LAC Joint Protec contains glucosamine, chondroitin, type 2 collagen, anti-inflammatory herbs, which help repair cartilage and relieve joint inflammation. It tastes good, is easy to take and convenient. Start ""refueling"" the cartilage and synovial fluid early so that the joints can be used for a longer time! 果冻形态的关节保健品，含葡萄糖胺、软骨素、第2型胶原蛋白、抗炎草本等关节保健营养素，有助于修复软骨和缓解关节发炎症状，味道好，容易服用又方便。提早开始给软骨和滑液“加加油”，关节才能用得久、用得顺！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - OTO Anyway Back Massage Cushion
programme.desc: A lightweight 4.5 kg cushion that turns any seat into a personal massage chair. Dual rollers on a full-length track relax from neck to hips and improve circulation. Simple controls make instant relaxation easy anytime, anywhere. 仅重 4.5 公斤，轻巧便携，椅子、沙发或车里都能用，一靠即可全背按摩。双滚轮从颈肩到腰臀，舒缓肌肉、促进循环。靠垫柔软贴合、支撑力佳、透气舒适，随时轻松放松。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Wiltshire Pink Board Bundle
programme.desc: All-in-one knife, scissors and board bundle that makes your life easier with an in-built knife sharpener! 全套组合菜刀、剪刀、砧板，让你下厨更轻松！菜刀和剪刀附专业磨刀套！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Karihome Gold Adult Goat Milk Powder
programme.desc: Enjoy the smooth taste of Karihome Gold Adult Goat Milk Powder, made with easy-to-digest goat milk proteins and enriched with lutein, collagen, and Omega-3. It supports eye, joint, and heart health, boosts calcium intake, and strengthens immunity. Perfect for the whole family, especially seniors, to maintain bone health and vitality with just two cups a day. Karihome Gold 成人羊奶粉口感顺滑，富含易吸收的羊奶蛋白，采用先进脱膻技术，保留营养与纯净口感，连肠胃敏感者都能安心饮用。 还特别添加叶黄素、胶原蛋白和 Omega-3，支持眼睛、关节及心脑血管健康。每天两杯，补钙增强免疫力，适合全家饮用，特别适合年长人士，助力骨骼健康与活力。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - EBENE Bio-Ray Plantar Fasciitis Compression Foot Sleeves
programme.desc: Targets plantar fasciitis: relieves pain, reduces swelling, and stabilises the plantar fascia. With Japanese Bio-Ray technology, the sleeves compress tendons and muscles to boost blood and oxygen circulation. Arch support ensures stability while walking or standing. Non-slip, soft, breathable—comfortable all day under socks or during activity. 支撑足弓，稳固筋膜，有效缓解疼痛和肿胀。袜子轻轻包覆脚部肌肉和筋腱，加上日本生化能技术，促进血气循环，让脚更舒适、更快恢复。防滑、柔软透气，全天穿都舒服，不管是运动还是穿袜子都合适！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Krafter Purple Magic Sheet
programme.desc: South Korea’s no. 1 Home Shopping product! A multi-purpose cleaning sheet that works wonders by effectively removing grease, stains, mould and odors on all surfaces! 韩国电视购物频台爆款！这万能布能有效地清理顽固的污渍， 油脂和气味！

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Philips Azur Steam Iron
programme.desc: The Philips Azur 8000 Series Steam Iron delivers powerful performance with OptimalTEMP technology, ensuring that no fabric will be burned. The intelligent temperature control guarantees no scorching, allowing you to iron both horizontally and vertically with ease. programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.desc: Katy needs help; she's feeling sick! Troy selects the most helpful, kindest car he knows: Amber the Ambulance!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: Soon after being released from prison, Babtou gets in trouble with the law again. Facing deportation to his foreign birthplace he’s never been to, he and his friend Dennis are willing to do anything to stay in the only home they've ever known: Frankfurt.

programme.title: Three Times Nothing
programme.desc: When three homeless friends win the lottery, they assume their lives are going to change drastically for the better. But claiming the money turns out to be more of a problem than a solution.

programme.title: Staring Into The Abyss
programme.desc: LKA officer David Wallat monitors released child murderer Joseph Maria Hagenow, now housed by a village pastor. As Hagenow manipulates his guards, a child’s disappearance threatens to unravel Wallat’s entire operation.

programme.title: I'm Not In Love
programme.desc: After receiving a marriage ultimatum from a woman he's not sure he truly loves, Rob is up against the clock to realise he should stop looking for the fabled 'Miss Right' and learn to see what's right in front of him.

programme.title: Masha
programme.desc: Masha has grown up between the boxing ring and the streets of her provincial Russian town. Her closest friends, young gangsters who are loathed by the entire town, love and protect her. And suddenly the cruel truth about them is revealed to her.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement
programme.desc: After waking in a hospital with no memory, Sarah Kohr is accused of shooting an innocent man following a violent accident. Determined to clear her name, she sets out to uncover the truth of what really happened that night.

programme.title: Elaha
programme.desc: Elaha, a young Kurdish-German woman, battles patriarchy and family expectations while seeking her own path. Elaha struggles with traditions, marriage and virginity, and she must choose between emancipation or delusion.

programme.title: Goodnight Mommy
programme.desc: In a secluded countryside home, ten-year-old twins grow suspicious when their mother returns from plastic surgery distant and unrecognizable. Isolated from the world, they embark on a quest to find out whether this woman is their mother.

programme.title: Cortina Express

programme.title: Falling Into Place
programme.desc: Kira and Ian meet all too briefly over a winter weekend on the Isle of Skye and form a sudden and deep bond. Back in London, they try to move on with their separate lives - but both have to stop running from themselves before they are ready to meet again.

programme.title: Out Of The Blue
programme.desc: A successful and dashing young man whose life of one-night stands seems to be going great until a teenybopper, claiming to be his daughter, knocks on his door.

programme.title: Murder Party
programme.desc: Jeanne, a brilliant architect, is appointed to restore the sumptuous Daguerre mansion owned by an eccentric family. When the patriarch is found dead during a murder party, Jeanne finds herself caught up in a real-life investigation to unmask the killer.

programme.title: Just Like A Woman
programme.desc: Two women travel from Chicago to Santa Fe to escape their suffocating lives. Marilyn dreams of winning a contest held by a famous belly dancing company, while her friend, Mona, has a darker secret.

programme.title: Wajma, An Afghan Love Story
programme.desc: In conservative Kabul, young Wajma discovers she is pregnant out of wedlock. Her boyfriend denies paternity and her father locks her up for being a disgrace. Driven by desperation, Wajma takes extreme measures forcing everyone to re-think their actions.

programme.title: Lightning-Struck
programme.desc: At her wedding in the Auvergne mountains, Lucie survives a lightning strike that kills her husband but leaves her with the ability to remember every moment of her life. At a reunion two years later, the survivors are targeted by a mysterious killer.

programme.title: Run Woman Run
programme.desc: When a steady diet of donuts, pizza, cake and cigarettes lands Beck in a diabetic coma, she receives a ghostly life coach in the form of legendary marathon hero Tom Longboat who helps her train for the run of her life.

programme.title: Raahein
programme.desc: A 75-year-old comatose man finds himself holding onto his past in his subconscious as his family outside considers letting him go.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Cédric works in a company specialized in precision mechanics. Its management, run by an investment fund, is disastrous. As another fund is about to buy it again, Cédric decides to take the company over, giving it to the employees.

programme.title: Governance
programme.desc: Renzo, a brilliant and unscrupulous manager is forced to quit his position as general manager of an oil group after an investigation for corruption. Convinced that a young colleague betrayed him, he plots his revenge, but the situation gets out of hand.

programme.title: Romancing The Jungle
programme.desc: Eva is a rookie journalist keen on investigating sea piracy. When she is really kidnapped by pirates in Thailand, she is forced to fight for her life. With her is a hunky smuggler called Nik, and together, the comedic duo band together to survive.

programme.title: Not My Type
programme.desc: A dashing philosopher is sent off to teach in a quiet northern town, where he soon falls for a bubbly and rather vulgar local hairdresser. But will the couple’s carnal affection manage to overcome their irreconcilable differences?

programme.title: Death Of Nintendo
programme.desc: In 90s Manila, as blackouts from the looming volcanic eruption disrupts their video game-filled days, four friends go on a journey of self-discovery. For Paolo, it’s a quest to impress the popular girl; for Mimaw, it’s the painful start of finding herself.

The overgrown patch of land on the side of the mountain has been untouched for more than a decade, and with no idea of what plants thrive in the Tuscan terrain, the best pals seek help from gardening oracle Warrie Price, who has spent over 30 years cultivating a 15-acre oasis.

programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Italian Job S02 - EP4
programme.desc: Alan takes charge of tackling the first bedroom, and he doesn't hold back with his design. Inspired by the romance and history of his favourite city Florence, he's determined to have a mural, but Amanda fears his creative juices could turn into a flood. To nail his aesthetic, Alan travels to the outskirts of the Tuscan capital to meet Jane at her medieval home decorated in rare 14th-century frescos.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Space

The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Circus
programme.desc: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Socks

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mountain Gorillas, The Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: When a cold-ridden Glitch's sneezing breaks his TV, the Grimbots take him to the Virunga National Park in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to see a real mountain gorilla. programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all…

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: After a royal coup, two princes are separated, one raised in Shaolin as Dao Xing, the other as Wu Zi Tai under a minister. Years later, they meet at Shaolin while seeking the Yi Jin Jing, unaware they are brothers, as hidden identities and destiny unfold amid rising conflict and danger.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiancé. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra's blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his father's old rival.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.
